Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: character reference sheet for the five reviewing jurists of a public GitHub project, binding for every later frame
Primary request: one wide sheet that fixes five distinct jurists, all carved from the SAME white marble, each recognizable by the shape of his hair and face alone.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column; Image 3 is a strip of five reference portraits — take ONLY the shapes from it: build of the head, hairline, the cut of the beard, the shape of the moustache, and the spectacles. Do not copy skin, hair colour, clothing or the photographic look; Image 4 is the approved monumental marble seat.
Subject: five white-marble portrait busts of five different men, standing in one row at the same scale on the ivory ground, each on its own small round marble base, each turned three-quarter toward the viewer. From left to right they must read as different people BY SHAPE ALONE:
1. a slender man with a neat narrow moustache and short parted hair, clean shaven otherwise;
2. a bald man with a full short beard and a heavy brow;
3. a broad man with a long sweeping moustache and thick swept-back hair, no beard;
4. a man with thick wavy hair and a full pointed beard;
5. an older man with round spectacles, a trimmed beard and a high forehead.
Below the row, one monumental marble seat from Image 4 stands empty at a three-quarter angle.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature, clearly separated from the busts. The five busts stand in one straight row across the upper two thirds with equal spacing, identical height and identical lighting, none overlapping, none cropped. Generous empty ivory space.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble sculpture render, finely carved surfaces, crisp edges, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, physically plausible materials, museum plate feeling
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and confident, identical lighting on every bust
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, WHITE MARBLE ONLY for every bust including all hair, beards, moustaches and spectacle frames, muted gold #C9A87A used only as a thin band on the round bases, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints, and the first one decides the sheet: EVERY bust is carved entirely from the same white marble, hair and beard included. Marble has no hair colour. There is no black, brown, grey or dark hair anywhere in the frame, no painted eyes, no skin tone, no tinted spectacle glass; the spectacles are thin marble or thin muted-gold wire, and the lenses are empty. The five men differ only by the SHAPE of hair, beard, moustache and face. All five are carved in one sculptural language so they read as one bench. Every bust rests on its base and nothing floats. Classical drapery over the shoulders instead of modern clothing. Anatomically correct features. Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: black hair, dark hair, coloured hair, painted or photographic skin, tinted lenses, modern jackets or uniforms, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, five identical faces, a female figure, blindfolds, scales, swords, callout labels
